description: We are Biovisuales! Our names are Joaquin (Biotechnology and Molecular Biology student) and Julia (Visual Design and User Experience student). Combining science and design is our mission. Let's work on amazing projects!
summary: We developed an educational experience inspired by classic fairytales and medieval manuscripts. It combines a short film, a website and a printable planner for school-aged people. In this project, we tell the adventures of Spirit and Opportunity. We chose to use a familiar storytelling format to introduce young people to space exploration.
details:
Our project combines human-made art and design with scientific research. It uses a familiar storytelling technique (a classic fairytale), to generate curiosity about space exploration in young users.

We used the following software/coding languages:

Figma for graphic design

Procreate for illustrations

Adobe Premiere for video and sound editing

HTML and CSS through Visual Studio Code for the website

Canva for the printable weekly planner

We used a laptop and an Ipad as our devices.

We decided on this medieval atmosphere, because it's contrast with the futurist aesthetic commonly used for these topics would spark curiosity on our audience. The classic illuminated manuscript, as it is historically called, brought us back to our childhood, where fairytales were told as amazing adventures. We wanted our audience to feel like that when they watched our short film.

We are two university students. As a Biotechnology student, Joaquin made sure that the scientific and historical facts on our script were correct. As a Visual Design student, Julia made sure to create attractive graphics and an engaging user experience having young people in mind.

Together, we proved that art and science can be used together to build amazing experiences that inspire young people to learn more about space.
